description: This PHP class 'VacancyListRSSController' generates an RSS feed containing published job vacancies for the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It handles HTTP responses and constructs an XML RSS document with vacancy details, including titles, links, and descriptions.

classes.name: VacancyListRSSController
classes.description: Controller responsible for generating RSS feed of published vacancies in the recruitment module.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles HTTP request and returns an XML RSS feed response with published vacancies.

methods.name: generateRSSFeed
methods.description: Constructs and returns an RSS XML string with vacancy data formatted for syndication.

methods.name: getPublishedVacancies
methods.description: Retrieves the list of published vacancies from the Vacancy DAO.
